description: Odisha govt invites bids for an AI-powered petition drafting system to modernize legal responses. Deadline: Sept 3, 2025.
body_lead: MediaNama’s Take: The Government of Odisha’s decision to integrate AI into the petition drafting process to increase administrative efficiency by automating routine tasks and extracting data for generating draft responses in legal formats can be a very useful and effective use of AI systems. However, concerns remain about how officials may use these tools beyond administrative purposes. When lawyers and administrative professionals begin to rely on AI for drafting suggestions or final responses, the trustworthiness of AI becomes the core issue.
